official_predict: _prime_rollout_cache caches frame 0 and the all-zero action condition chunk.
_rollout_video_frame is called with action_mode=false and receives only video tokens.
_rollout_action_chunk is called after all future video frames have been generated.
training_path: NavSimEpisodeDataset keeps action chunk 0 zero and puts future trajectory deltas in chunk 1.
Trainer._build_joint_sampling_input presents future noisy action tokens and future noisy video tokens jointly during training.
adapter_path: condition_chunk=0 replaces the training-time zero action condition with an external action; this is out-of-distribution and is not the trained future-action path.

condition_chunk=1 writes a future action chunk into the cache before the video loop, but the video loop still executes the single-stream video-only inference path; this is not equivalent to the joint training input.

pilot.interpretation: The injection hook executed, but generated longitudinal motion was not monotonic with the injected speed role. This is a valid negative coupling result, not a visual-layer failure.

joint_sampler_probe.sampler: training-layout joint forward_train probe with clean external future action tokens
joint_sampler_probe.interpretation: The experimental joint path runs end-to-end but does not produce monotonic longitudinal response. Because it uses an eager attention fallback and unavailable future visual condition tokens, this remains a diagnostic probe rather than a formal RCS score.

decision.next_valid_experiment: Do not expand this sampler. A formal causal test requires a released inference path whose action-conditioned video inputs match the training distribution, or a checkpoint explicitly trained for external action-conditioned video generation.
decision.fallback: If a joint sampler cannot be justified from the released checkpoint, report DriveWAM RCS-progress as unverified and do not claim action-to-video response.
